title: Section 79 — Suits by or against Government — CPC 1908

content.heading: Suits by or against Government
content.text: In a suit by or against the Government, the authority to be named as plaintiff or defendant, as the case may be, shall be — in the case of a suit by or against the Central Government, the Union of India; and in the case of a suit by or against a State Government, the State.
